d:
Jailed Khadoor Sahib MP Amritpal Singh has been granted three-hour custody parole, from 12 PM to 3 PM, to attend his grandmother Charan Kaur’s cremation in Jallupur Khera village, Amritsar.
After being brought from Dibrugarh jail via Amritsar airport, he is being taken to the village under police escort. A sizable crowd has gathered, with police personnel deployed to regulate traffic and maintain security.
